BrochureContent.Content:
Hooke and MacDonald are delighted to present to the market this fully furnished 2 bedroom apartment located in the heart of Liberties in Dublin City Centre.

This spacious apartment consists of two double bedrooms ,two bathrooms, kitchen, living & dining area combined.

The bedrooms are especially peaceful to sleep in located at the back of the apartment overlooking a pleasant garden/courtyard below.

Rent includes parking and WIFI

The Guinness Storehouse, Teeling Whiskey Distillery, Newmarket Square Markets, Francis Street Antique Shops, St Patricks Cathedral, Christ Church Cathedral, Thomas Street National College of Art, famous Dublin Castle, the Chester Beatty Library and Trinity College/University- are all just a stones throw away from Cork Street.
